name: application-mega-menu-panel
title: Mega Menu Panel
description: A full-width dropdown panel opened from a top-nav item, organizing links into labeled columns alongside a featured promo card.
useWhen: A top-level nav item has enough sub-pages or product lines that a simple dropdown list would be too long or unstructured.
You want to surface a featured or promotional item (a new feature, an announcement) alongside a link browsing experience.
avoidWhen: The nav item has fewer than about 6 links — the existing `dropdown` component is simpler and less visually heavy.
The wide-panel layout doesn't fit narrow viewports — collapse to an accordion or the `navigation-menu` pattern on mobile instead.
responsiveBehavior: The panel's grid columns are sized in a fixed max-width container; below the width needed for all columns, collapse to a single-column accordion or a full-screen mobile nav instead of shrinking columns further.
accessibility: The trigger button carries aria-expanded reflecting whether the panel is open.
Each column has a visible heading grouping its links, giving the link list structure beyond visual position alone.
The featured card's 'New' badge is paired with descriptive text and a text link, not conveyed by badge color alone.

variants.title: Product menu
variants.description: A top nav bar with an open 'Products' mega menu: three labeled link-group columns (Build, Ship, Learn) plus a featured announcement card.
accessibility: The 'Products' trigger carries aria-expanded="true" while its panel is open.

variants.title: Product menu (Dark)
variants.description: Mega menu panel adapted for dark surfaces, including the featured card's background and badge colors.
accessibility: Column headings, link text, and the featured card all meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark panel background.
